temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin admits he is not happy with his job, feels stuck and unfulfilled, is unsure where to start, and agrees that he and Angela can figure out options together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Kevin may be unhappy with his construction job; Angela is concerned but not fully certain about the details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—her concern is confirmed and deepened: Kevin is genuinely unhappy, feels stuck and unfulfilled, and is open to exploring options with her support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is unhappy with his job and willing to explore what might make him happier, possibly with Angela’s help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Kevin explore options and figure out what might be a better fit for him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin thanks Angela for the job openings and career counseling information, says he has been thinking a lot, and reveals interest in something more creative, maybe design or architecture. He says he will check the resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Kevin is considering a career change, and Angela feels supportive and hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—she learns more specific information: Kevin is leaning toward creative work, especially design or architecture, and is receptive to the resources she shared.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is interested in a creative career, possibly design or architecture, and is willing to explore the resources Angela provided.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue encouraging Kevin by sharing resources and supporting his exploration of design or architecture.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin says Angela did not have to arrange the career coach meeting, appreciates it, but is not sure he is ready. After Angela encourages him, he agrees to give it a shot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Kevin is considering a career change, but Angela believes he is hesitant about making the change; she feels frustrated and worried.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—her belief that he is hesitant is confirmed, but she also learns he is willing to try when encouraged. Her belief shifts to Kevin being hesitant but reachable with support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is hesitant about the career change, but he has agreed to meet with a career coach and can be motivated with encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Frustrated and worried before he agrees; encouraged and hopeful after he agrees to try.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Motivate Kevin to attend the career coach meeting and support him through the process.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin reports that the career coach has been helpful, he has started taking online design courses, and he feels more confident about the change. He says Angela’s support is enough for now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believes Kevin is making progress in his career transition and feels proud and relieved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—her belief is confirmed and strengthened: Kevin is actively taking courses and gaining confidence through the coach.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is making real progress in his career transition, is taking design courses, and is becoming more confident.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue checking in on Kevin and offering help as he progresses.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Angela announces she organized a celebration party for Kevin. Kevin thanks her, says it means a lot, expresses gratitude for her support, and agrees to celebrate.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believes Kevin has successfully transitioned to a new career and feels happy and satisfied.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major belief change—Kevin’s gratitude confirms that he appreciates her support and that the transition effort was worth celebrating.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin has successfully transitioned to a new career and is grateful for Angela’s support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Celebrate Kevin’s success and enjoy the party with him.
